items.title: Free Cleaning Business Starter Guide
items.description: Thinking of starting a cleaning business? Fill in a short form and get Kaffy's free starter guide, written from the experience of building Smart Girl Cleaning Services from scratch.

items.title: Your Roadmap to Becoming a Clean Guru
items.description: Kaffy's first book, for anyone who wants to build a cleaning business. Written from the experience of starting Smart Girl Cleaning Services from one small room in Ilorin.

items.title: Cleaning Calculator Pro
items.description: The all-in-one app for cleaning business owners. Price any job, then create quotations, invoices and proposals and send them straight to clients. A dashboard tracks every invoice you send, your terms and conditions are built in, and it works offline.

items.title: Smart Cleaners Academy app
items.description: Learn professional cleaning step by step, from safety and products to real cleaning missions, in an app built for cleaners and cleaning teams.

items.title: The cleaning game
items.description: Learn cleaning by playing. A game that teaches the right products, tools and order of work, one mission at a time.

items.title: Smart Entrepreneurs Community
items.description: A paid WhatsApp community for entrepreneurs who want to grow alongside people who are building too. Tap to request to join. Once your request comes in, Kaffy will send you the payment details to complete your membership.
